Tattoo Shop

Welcome to the Odoo Tattoo Shop package! This guide will help you manage your Tattoo shop efficiently. Manage new opportunities, consent forms, your social media presence and your bookings. 

Basics

Your Odoo Tattoo Shop package includes essential apps to streamline your operations:

  • Use the CRM App to manage your leads and track ongoing tattoo projects.
  • Handle consent forms and important documents effortlessly with the Sign App.
  • Showcase your work, attract new clients through the Website App.
  • Let your customers book and manage appointments through the Appointments App.
  • Share your latest creations and engage with your audience using the Social Marketing App.
  • Restock supplies with ease using the Purchase App.
  • Manage your opportunities through Activities.
⚠️

If you want to easily discover every features of this package, try downloading the Demo Data.

You can still do it by upgrading your package in Apps.

Just be careful, once demo data are uploaded, it cannot be easily deleted. But you can restart a fresh database on Odoo.com/trial

Customer Management 😊

The CRM app is your central hub for : 
  • Managing new walk-ins, appointments, and customers
  • Communicating with your customers, artists, and managing to-do's and reminders
  • Sending and receiving signed customer consent forms
  • Creating quotations and confirming them
  • Following-up internally or externally through CRM activities 
💡

Tags are linked to the website contact form. 

Create new tags in order to provide more customer choice when asking for more information about what they're after. 

🎓 CRM

Website management 🌐

Your website is great for :
  • Showcasing your artists and their work, and acquiring new opportunities
  • Provide visitors with a way to book appointments for flash tattoos and piercings
  • Presenting a contact form for customers that wish to have a custom tattoo
💡
Boost your online presence

Working on your website and having other website reference it boosts your ranking in search engines. 

Don't forget to link your social media to it, in order to generate clicks and obtain new leads!


🎓 Website

Appointment scheduling 📅

Manage customer appointments through a website appointment form. 
  • Appointments create new opportunities
  • Get an intuitive overview of your customer appointments in the calendar view
  • Set-up new appointments on the go
💡
Appointments create opportunities too!

Keep track of new appointments in the CRM app, and create new appointment types for other services you may offer.

🎓 Appointments

Social marketing 💕

  • Keep in touch with admirers of your work 
  • Schedule and Post your content to multiple channel in a single click
  • Create and keep track of your campaigns
🎓 Social Marketing

Sign ✍️

  • Manage your consent forms and employment contracts in one place
  • Automatically send consent forms to customers digitally when the time is right
💡
Templates can be signed by multiple parties

Fields can be added to any template, and can specify who will sign it. 

🎓 Sign


Sales & Invoicing 💶

  • Customer wants a quotation? Create a quotation from any opportunity in a few clicks
  • Goods and services can be created and sold on the fly
  • Obtain accurate reporting on what you're selling

🎓 Sales


✅

Tips for Success

Optimize your CRM

  • Add automated e-mail actions to CRM stages for customer communication
  • Create template activities for common to-do's
Add your consent forms & other contracts to the Sign app

  • One place to manage all your legal documents
  • Save time by sending them automatically when changing CRM stages
Stay ahead of your marketing needs by using Marketing Campaigns

  • Social media content is king. Launch new campaigns, share your work, and track follower statistics right from the Social Marketing app
  • Explore additional marketing channels that can be leveraged by Odoo
​

Do You Want to Go Further?

Odoo offers additional possibilities to enhance your Tattoo Shop business:

  • The Point of Sale can be used for instant payments 
  • Add SMS Marketing to send reminders to your customers
  • Install the ​​​Projects app for Tattoo's that require more sessions
🚀

Would you like to discuss your Odoo setup with us or explore more features?

We already cannot wait for the next one🏃



And that's all for this month, folks!
Thanks for reading, see you soon.👋

Tiny House Catalog


Available Models ✅


How to find the perfect model for your needs 😍

Here is a short guide that will help you pick the right tiny house for you.


1. How many people will live in this house?

While tiny houses are inherently small, it's important to prioritize comfort when sharing such limited space. To ensure everyone's happiness, we recommend allowing at least 9m² per person. If you plan to live with multiple roommates, our Serenità model is highly recommended, providing ample space for each individual to enjoy

🏢 House Model - Serenità


2. What is your budget?

While tiny houses do offer a more cost-effective alternative to traditional houses, at MyCompany, we prioritize durability, which comes with a price. However, if you're on a tight budget, we have the perfect solution: our Cielo model.
It provides everything you need while allowing you to save.

🏠 House Model - Cielo


3. Which style do you prefer: Natural or Industrial?

Whether your heart leans towards the rustic charm of a wooden hut or the intricate beauty of Victorian steelworks, we have you covered. Desiring a specific option? Rest assured, we are here to fulfill your wishes! Just get in touch with our architects and we will make sure to provide any specific choice you desire.

Natural Style ☘ -🏘️ House Model - Incanto

Industrial ⚙-🛕 House Model - Dolcezza


4. What can I do if I haven't found exactly what I wanted?"

If none of those offers convinced you, just get in touch with our team.
At MyCompany, your happiness is our utmost priority, and we'll go the extra mile to make sure you find what you're looking for!

HR FAQ


Expense Policy

Who do I need to address if I need office supplies?

Instead of setting up complicated processes, we prefer to let our employees buy whatever they need. Just fill in an expense and we will reimburse you.


Why has my expense not been reimbursed? It has been accepted.

The Accounting team handles all payments on Fridays afternoon.
If 2 weeks have passed and you are still waiting to be paid, get in touch with them.


Car Policy

How do I know which model I can order or not?

Our catalog can be found here and is updated every 2 years. If you do not manage to find the specific model you are looking for, contact our FleetOfficer


Who can drive my car?

Your car can be driven by you, your spouse and by any person living under the same roof as long as they have a valid permit.

Usage

Brand Name Rules

YourCompany is very proud of its brand image.
When representing the brand, we thus ask you to be very cautious in how you refer to the company.

Do

  • Capitalize the word YourCompany, except if it's part of an URL e.g. website/company
  • Always type YourCompany in the same font size and style as the content of the text
  • Write it without any article(the YourCompany, a YourCompany, ...)

Do Not

  • Pluralize the trademark (e.g.YourCompanies)
  • Use the logo instead of the word inside sentences
  • Use the expression "YourCompanions" to refer to our community

The 5 Commandments

  1. My Forecast will always be accurate and up-to-date
  2. All my activities will always be encoded in our CRM
  3. I will only sell a project if I am convinced it can be a success
  4. I will not steal prospects from colleagues
  5. I will not waste time and energy bad-mouthing competitors


Tips to close more deals

  • Be assertive but listen to what is being said
  • Identify the pain points and offer clear solutions
  • Prepare your demos in advance and integrate the prospect's use case into it
